newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen down or stabilising.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen down or stabilising.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to extend recent falls or stabilise on the back of Monday's balanced post-fixing trade and continuous trade losses.
Analysts said the Warsaw bourse which has been falling for the last three sessions should at least slow its losses after Wall Street's gain on Monday.
They said Espebepe might tumble after the meeting of creditors of the debt-ridden firm was postponed on Monday until May 16.
